evidence.title: Newly obtained footage shows Iran attack on major U.S. post in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Central Command attack reports and launch tracking
occurrences.quote_span: Once the war started, Iranian attacks, some originating from Iraq, repeatedly threatened the installation.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. military installation records and maps
occurrences.quote_span: Camp Buehring, or CBKU, sits about 25 miles from the Iraqi border and has for more than two decades served as a major staging ground for American forces deploying across the Middle East.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Original video metadata and Camp Buehring incident records
occurrences.quote_span: The footage obtained by CBS News was recorded by a person stationed on the ground at Camp Buehring, and captures the moments of impact and their explosive aftermath.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Pentagon deployment and troop-movement records for Camp Buehring
occurrences.quote_span: Ahead of the war, sources said most of the roughly 7,000 troops there were moved elsewhere — as were the majority of U.S. forces in Kuwait — as a part of the Pentagon's "get off the X" plan, military shorthand for moving away from a position vulnerable to attack.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News sources
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Camp Buehring damage assessments and Army reinforcement records
occurrences.quote_span: "CBKU got demolished," the source added. "They need to do an investigation. How come no one came to reinforce us?"
occurrences.speaker: Anonymous source
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: CBS News correspondence with U.S. Central Command
occurrences.quote_span: Contacted by CBS News, U.S. Central Command, the primary unit which oversees American military operations across the Middle East, declined to comment.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Central Command
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Army logistics and ammunition availability records
occurrences.quote_span: A senior Army official working in logistics, managing operations from another post in Kuwait, confirmed to CBS News there were concerns about the availability of .50 caliber ammunition and other "exquisite" munitions like Patriot missile batteries.
occurrences.speaker: Senior Army official
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Camp Buehring attack logs and bunker-alarm records
occurrences.quote_span: Missiles and drones forced soldiers into bunkers.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Army personnel and deployment records for Camp Buehring
occurrences.quote_span: While most of the U.S. service members were moved off of Camp Buehring, a tranche of more than 100 soldiers stayed behind.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: CBS News video files and U.S. military incident records for Camp Buehring
occurrences.quote_span: New videos obtained exclusively by CBS News show Iranian attacks on a major U.S. military base in Kuwait as the war with Iran kicked off seven months ago.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Army evacuation and base-closure records for Camp Buehring
occurrences.quote_span: "They hit us bad," the source told CBS News on condition of anonymity because of the military's strict media restrictions. "It was horrible. There were a lot of brave guys who stayed to fight there — and people at home don't know what happened. We had to abandon the base."
occurrences.speaker: Anonymous source
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. service-member testimony and Defense Department air-operations records
occurrences.quote_span: Three U.S. service members told CBS News that Iranian F-5 fighter jets were also used during the attacks, a detail first reported in April by NBC News.
occurrences.speaker: Three U.S. service members
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Army force-protection assessments and Camp Buehring emergency-planning records
occurrences.quote_span: The service members feared the isolated base was ill-equipped to handle a mass-casualty event if the attacks continued.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Camp Buehring damage assessments and video evidence
occurrences.quote_span: Damage to buildings and military equipment can also be seen in the videos.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Army ammunition issue and resupply records for Camp Buehring
occurrences.quote_span: CBS News has learned that soldiers defending the base ran critically low on .50-caliber ammunition as some soldiers were repositioned into the Udari Desert in Kuwait.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: CBS News photographs and damage assessments at Prince Sultan Air Base and Camp Arifjan
occurrences.quote_span: Beyond Camp Buehring, CBS News earlier obtained exclusive photos of damage at Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia and Camp Arifjan in Kuwait.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Department of Defense casualty announcement for the Port of Shuaiba attack
occurrences.quote_span: CBS News has also reported extensively on the deadliest attack of the war against U.S. troops at the Port of Shuaiba, which killed six American service members.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring

occurrences.checkable_against: Pentagon response to CBS News and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's March 4 remarks
occurrences.quote_span: The Pentagon did not comment, but pointed back to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's comments on March 4 regarding the removal of U.S. troops from bases and the employment of defensive measures.
occurrences.speaker: The Pentagon
occurrences.subject: Iranian attacks on Camp Buehring
